rows.grounds: indeclinable adverb marking duration or extent; completes the preceding statement about deceitful-hearted denial

items.question: For how long do crooked-minded deceitful-hearted people claim that seen and unseen means are useless?
premises: Crooked-minded people deny usefulness of means.
Yāvat marks duration of their denial.
Seen and unseen means are at stake.
items.inference: Their denial persists only for a limited span.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic scope of yāvat in the verse is unclear.
items.plain_english: As long as they persist in saying so.
